The Bottle

Anatomy of conscious design

The AAB کور 2L Insulated Bottle pairs a generous two-litre capacity with materials chosen for the planet, not just the spec sheet. Every surface, seal and stitch is built to last a lifetime — and to leave no trace when it eventually does.

90% Recycled Food-Grade Stainless Steel Body

Double-walled stainless core, reclaimed and refined — food-safe, rust-proof and endlessly reusable.

Plant-Based, Plastic-Free Lid

Derived from renewable plant composites and naturally biodegradable — no micro-plastics, ever.

Leak-Proof Cap, Natural Silicone Seal

A secure integrated lid with a plant-safe silicone gasket — toss it in any bag with total confidence.

Built-In Brass Carabiner

Clip it to your pack, your pram, your desk — hands-free hydration that follows you everywhere.

Our social mission

Every bottle gives back

We didn’t want to make “just another bottle”. AAB کور is built as a small, daily act of restoration — measurable, transparent and automatic with every purchase.

0kg

Ocean plastic, retrieved

The sale of every single bottle funds the retrieval of five kilograms of ocean plastic — intercepted before it can drift into the food chain.

0tree

Mangroves, planted

Each purchase plants one mangrove tree — the coastline’s fiercest carbon sink and nursery for marine life, restoring ecosystems one root at a time.

Small choices, multiplied by every AAB owner, become a movement.  That’s the point.
